resources.string: Browse the home page, open a card for details, and play a video. Search, browsing, and streaming do not require a membership. Sign in to the website only for features tied to its account.

The button beside search translates Chinese or English queries into Japanese. You can edit the result before searching. Automatic translation in Settings covers home titles, search result titles, and detail descriptions. The first use downloads an on-device model.

The media library supports collections and filters. Settings contains backup, restore, and WebDAV sync. Download management offers queues and concurrency controls. Configure your own storage and sync service as needed.

Advanced tools such as automatic organization, scheduled backups, device sync, and download optimization are planned for Pro. There are currently no payment restrictions or checkout. Browsing, playback, and basic translation are planned to remain free.
